Comments.ApplicationObjectId: The Object ID of the App Registration (not the Application/Client ID). Required for Graph API calls.
Comments.ManagedIdentityClientId: Set this to the Client ID of your USER-ASSIGNED managed identity. Leave empty to use SYSTEM-ASSIGNED identity.
Comments.CosmosDbConnectionString: Set to your Cosmos DB connection string to enable persistent storage. Leave empty to use in-memory storage.
Comments.AzureContainerRegistryDefaultSubscriptio: Default Azure subscription ID for ACR resources if not specified per registry.
Comments.AzureContainerRegistryCleanupIntervalHou: How often to run automatic cleanup of expired tokens and unused scope maps.
Comments.AzureContainerRegistryTokenExpiryDays: Default expiry period for tokens if not specified when creating.
